the global trading system is quietly repricing around a world where the strait of hormuz is a war zone.

not a headline.
the new baseline.

a surprisingly good month for putin. 

russia making bank on oil, gas. fertilizer. us sanctions suspended. us weapons now prioritized for iran war. russia supporting iran without consequence. and a russian tanker with oil now allowed through to cuba by the americans.

trump can’t reopen the strait of hormuz with an air campaign. and the iranians aren’t going to accept that outcome willingly. 

ground troops are coming.

spotted in the hood - “hoooo is it?”
unclear why it took four weeks for a us leader to say this. it’s been the big problem since the beginning.
what if this time trump promises not to kill any iranians involved in negotiations?

oil disruption: russia’s invasion of ukraine compared to us/israel war in iran. 

not even close…
oil markets getting desensitized to trump’s truth social posts

this is the biggest problem with a trump off-ramp. and there’s no way to stop it without risky and costly escalation. 

it’s a primary reason boots on the ground are likely.

SECRETARY RUBIO: One of the immediate challenges we're going to face is an Iran that may decide that they want to set up a tolling system in the Strait of Hormuz. Not only is this illegal, it's unacceptable, it's dangerous for the world.

the momentum on this is real and it needs to be.

g7 foreign ministers meeting in france today. on the agenda: stop the war, end iran's nuclear program, reopen the strait of hormuz.
also on the agenda, implicitly: explain to allies why the us launched this war without telling them and ask them to help fix it.

four weeks in, iran continues to export oil through the strait of hormuz. 

1.5 million barrels a day, at significantly higher prices than before the war.

new trump deadline just dropped.

strait still near completely closed for next two weeks? yes.
trump with second delay on self-imposed deadline…now paused until us troops are expected to arrive in persian gulf.

“no way!”
“way.”
